title: Expand safety gate for generic Agent execution
purpose: Upgrade the existing safety regression gate so it validates generic Agent execution paths, not only isolated substrate modules.
scope: Add end-to-end runtime safety scenarios to safety gate manifest.
Cover model output injection, observation injection, memory poisoning, approval bypass, source-to-sink abuse, and recovery abuse.
Assert that denied paths do not emit EffectPrepared.
Assert that half-committed paths enter Recovery or RollbackPending.
Add CI workflow updates for the new runtime safety subset.
Record safety scenario coverage in evidence.
acceptance_criteria: The safety gate fails if AgentCore can bypass ToolRouter or PolicyEvaluator.
The safety gate fails if untrusted content can trigger high-risk tools directly.
The safety gate fails if secret values are stored in memory or model context.
The safety gate fails if approval parameter mutation is accepted.
The safety gate fails if recovery cannot classify half-executed effects.
verification: Run CI workflow locally where possible.
risk_notes: Safety gates must reflect the actual runtime path users will exercise.
implementation_steps: Extend the safety manifest from MVP substrate scenarios to generic Agent execution scenarios.
Require model output injection, observation injection, memory poisoning, approval mutation, source-to-sink abuse, secret misuse, and recovery abuse cases.
Assert denied paths do not emit EffectPrepared.
Assert half-committed paths enter Recovery, RollbackPending, or FailedClosed.
Wire safety:: and agent_core::adversarial commands into CI and release scripts.
Record scenario names, commands, and expected gate behavior in evidence.
failure_modes: CI or release omits runtime adversarial suite.
Safety gate only covers isolated substrate functions and misses generic runtime bypasses.
Half-executed effect has no recovery classification.
Gate output is too vague to identify planning, policy, memory, approval, or execution failure domain.

verification_matrix.expected: prompt injection, tool abuse, resource abuse, secret, rollback, and recovery gates pass
model, observation, memory, approval, and malformed output abuse cases fail closed
expanded gates do not regress valid AgentCore flows

blocked_until: CI and release scripts include safety and adversarial suites.
